description: Polymarket order book for one market outcome from the CLOB: bids and asks (price and size) up to 50 levels, best bid and ask, mid, spread and USD depth within 5 cents of the mid on each side. Give the market slug and outcome, or a CLOB token id. Use to check liquidity and slippage before a trade, or to read a sharper price than the last trade. Example: slug=will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republican-presidential-nomination. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

outcome.description: Outcome name, e.g. Yes or No (default the first outcome)

slug.description: The market's Polymarket slug (from polymarket_markets) or its polymarket.com URL

token_id.description: Instead of slug: the CLOB token id of one outcome

name: polymarket_orderbook
title: Polymarket order book
